required_check: Require future_label_for_research_only fields to be absent from input feature sections.
reject_if: horizon_ms, effective_future_row_delta_count, hyperliquid_future_mid_move_ticks, or aliases appear as input features.
notes: Future labels are offline outputs only.

required_check: Require future labels to be absent from row selection, filtering, and clean-context conditions.
reject_if: Any future label is used to select, filter, include, exclude, or define a case row.
notes: Clean context must be decision-time visible and inherited from T004/T003.

required_check: Require future labels to be absent from executable trigger, rule, or signal sections.
reject_if: Any future label appears in trigger, rule, signal, alert, or action-condition language.

required_check: Require no future label in shadow side, shadow action, shadow quote, or shadow decision fields.
reject_if: A future label influences or is stored as a shadow decision field.

required_check: Require future labels to be absent from live/default-on/tiny-live/deployment decision sections.
reject_if: A future label is used for live readiness, deployment, default-on, tiny-live, or promotion claims.
notes: Future labels cannot drive live or deployment decisions.

required_check: Require future labels to be joined only after decision-time context is fixed and only as outputs.
reject_if: Future labels are joined before context construction or are available to context field derivation.

required_check: Require alias scans for future outcome, markout, future move, horizon result, hit, wrong-way, or outcome-as-input names.
reject_if: A future-label alias is categorized as decision_time_visible_context or diagnostic_context input.
notes: Alias checks must be part of a later validator.

required_check: Require case_label to be inherited from T004 labels, not computed from future outcomes.
reject_if: case_label uses future mid move, hit rate, wrong-way loss, or horizon output as a condition.
notes: Read-only labels cannot become hindsight-selected cases.

required_check: Scan free-text metadata for future-label-as-input or outcome-selected language.
reject_if: Text says future outcome drives input, trigger, filter, condition, shadow decision, live decision, or deployment.
notes: Text leakage is rejected even if columns look clean.

required_check: Require a future validator output proving future labels are output-only.
reject_if: No validation trace exists for future-label output-only proof.
notes: T006 defines the requirement only; no validator code is implemented here.
